request: Remove the fixed 1,000-entry local directory ceiling from Knowledge Map scans so a directory is bounded by its configured source budgets and reports incomplete coverage explicitly.

change.implementation: The direct local scan derives its per-directory ReadDir safety bound from the remaining file and directory budget for that source, plus one look-ahead entry. If that bound is exceeded, the graph remains explicitly partial. Added a regression case with 1,105 files in one directory and sufficient configured budget.
